title: Foxes do it in the snow… facing north 🦊❄️
caption:
They really do it in the snow, and almost always facing north-east 🦊🧭
Nature is weirder than you think 👇
sources: Červený J. et al. (2011) 'Directional preference may enhance hunting accuracy in foraging foxes', Biology Letters 7(3): 355-357 (about 73% success for north-east jumps vs about 18% for most other directions)
National Geographic coverage of the study (2011)
